evidence: Carries the Scripts and tools label and modifies contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py, the script used to verify release binaries.
rationale: Fixes a critical security logic flaw where untrusted and revoked signatures satisfied the required verification threshold. In verify.py, num_trusted was incorrectly computed as len(good_trusted) + len(good_untrusted), allowing any valid signature in a local GPG keyring to pass threshold verification without matching trusted keys.
